shortDescription: Manages router profiles for message-routing protocols

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the router profile.

options.name: ignore_client_port
options.description: When C(true), the remote port on clientside connections (connections where the peer connected to the BIG-IP) is ignored when searching for an existing connection.

options.name: inherited_traffic_group
options.description: When set to C(true), the C(traffic_group) is inherited from the containing folder. When not specified, the system sets this to C(false) when creating new router profile.

options.name: max_pending_bytes
options.description: The maximum number of bytes worth of pending messages that will be held while waiting for a connection to a peer to be created. Once reached, any additional messages to the peer will be flagged as undeliverable and returned to the originator. The accepted range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: max_pending_messages
options.description: The maximum number of pending messages that will be held while waiting for a connection to a peer to be created. Once reached, any additional messages to the peer will be flagged as undeliverable and returned to the originator. The accepted range is between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

options.name: max_retries
options.description: Sets the maximum number of time a message may be resubmitted for rerouting by the C(MR::retry) iRule command. The accepted range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: mirror
options.description: Enables or disables state mirroring. State mirroring can be used to maintain the same state information in the standby unit that is in the active unit.

options.name: mirrored_msg_sweeper_interval
options.description: Specifies the maximum time in milliseconds that a message will be held on the standby device as it waits for the active device to route the message. Messages on the standby device held for longer than the configurable sweeper interval, will be dropped. The acceptable range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the router profile.

options.name: parent
options.description: The parent template of this router profile. Once this value has been set, it cannot be changed. The default values are set by the system if not specified and they correspond to the router type created, for example, C(/Common/messagerouter) for C(generic) C(type) and so on.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to create router profile on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: routes
options.description: Specifies a list of static routes for the router instance to use. The route must be on the same partition as router profile.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the router profile exists. When C(absent), ensures the router profile is removed.

options.name: traffic_group
options.description: Specifies the traffic-group of the router profile. Setting the C(traffic_group) to an empty string value C("") will cause the device to inherit from containing folder, which means the value of C(inherited_traffic_group) on device will be C(true).

options.name: type
options.description: Parameter used to specify the type of the router profile to manage. Default setting is C(generic) with more options coming.

options.name: use_local_connection
options.description: If C(true), the router will route a message to an existing connection on the same TMM as the message was received.
